entries.gap: IHP SG13G2 draws the slits of a wide metal on datatype 24 of the metal layer. The openems adapter reads datatype 0 only, so a slotted ground plane becomes a solid plane.
entries.symptom: No message. On a three-port junction over a slotted Metal1/Metal2 ground, the reflections differ by 1.1 dB to 1.2 dB from a model with the slits, at every frequency from 1 GHz; with the slits cut, the difference is 0.2 dB at 1 GHz.
entries.workaround: Give the input cut {"Metal1": [24], "Metal2": [24], ...} for each slotted layer. Check the metal area in plan.json against the drawing minus the slits.
entries.evidence: README.md, section EM S-parameters (validation against a stored multi-layer model)

entries.gap: A TopMetal2 line over a 120 um Metal1 ground (SG13G2_200um.xml stackup, PML_8 on the sides and the top, PEC at the bottom, margin_um 200) stops at an energy level when the line is long: 700 um stays at -26 dB, 800 um at -20 dB; 600 um reaches -41 dB. With margin_um 400 the 800 um line reaches -40 dB in 32430 time steps; with PML at the bottom (no PEC backside) -41 dB in 16920. Probable cause: a wave guided in the PEC-backed substrate that the PML absorbs badly at 200 um of margin.
entries.symptom: The port job fails with 'the end criterion -40 dB was not reached'; the energy stays at -20 dB to -26 dB.
entries.workaround: Raise margin_um to 400 (keeps the PEC backside). PML at the bottom also converges but removes the backside metal.
entries.evidence: simulated, openEMS 0.37: five one-port runs of 60000 time steps (600, 700, 800 um; 800 um with margin_um 400; 800 um with PML at the bottom)
